INPUT=$(cat); CMD=$(echo "$INPUT" | jq -r '.tool_input.command // ""'); if echo "$CMD" | grep -qE '^\s*git\s+push'; then SECRETS=$(git diff --cached 2>/dev/null | grep -iE '(AKIA[0-9A-Z]{16}|api[_-]?key\s*[:=]|token\s*[:=]|password\s*[:=]|secret\s*[:=]|\.secrets/)' || true); if [ -n "$SECRETS" ]; then echo '{"decision":"block","reason":"BLOCKED: Potential secrets detected in staged files. Review with git diff --cached before pushing."}'; exit 2; fi; fi

INPUT=$(cat); CMD=$(echo "$INPUT" | jq -r '.tool_input.command // ""'); if echo "$CMD" | grep -qE '(^\s*git\s+commit|gacp_)'; then REPO=$(basename "$(pwd)"); MSG=$(echo "$CMD" | grep -oP '(?<=-m\s[\x27"])[^\x27"]*' || echo "$CMD"); logger -n 192.168.5.25 -P 514 --udp -t claude-hook -p local0.info "GIT_COMMIT: repo=$REPO msg=$MSG from claude session" 2>/dev/null || true; fi
